_comment: Transform control for ssrf_public_host_delegation.json. It must exit 1 with both mutants ESCAPED. These two sites are the ones a pre-existing test could not see: each site's OLDER neighbour test was measured green with the same mutant applied, because a second, still-intact guard refuses the same host. A CAUGHT here would mean the mutants break parsing or execution rather than behaviour, and every CAUGHT in the main battery would be worthless.
subject: transform control -- the two fail-open mutants remain executable and are NOT caught by the neighbour tests that predate this battery
